Settings

Arena theme

Controls

Move / sprintWASD / SHIFTSprint reset after a hitHOLD SHIFT · TAP WJump / double jumpSPACE / SPACE AGAINCrouchC or CTRLChange cameraVStrike / guardLMB / RMBSelect hotbar slot1–9 / MOUSE WHEELDraw / shoot bowHOLD / RELEASE LMBDrink / change potionQ / ZInventory / interactE / FReturn to ledgeRChat / leaderboardT / TAB

Every click swings immediately. Aim at the body and manage your reach. Direct hits have 0.5 seconds of immunity. Hold Shift and briefly release W after a landed hit to restore sprint knockback. Falling strikes can crit.

E opens your 20-slot inventory. Drag items between your backpack and hotbar, or select an item and then its destination. The hotbar is part of the same 20 slots. G drops an item. Use 1–9 or the mouse wheel to switch. F interacts with ledge shops, safe chest storage, the 2v2 sign, and dropped items.

Purchases are individual copies. Common carried gear is lost on death; rare or better gear drops for 5 minutes. Chest storage and your starter kit stay safe. R returns to the ledge after 3 seconds out of combat. Take cover under the bridge during cave-ins and eruptions.

Commands

Press T or / to enter a command. Admin protects against damage and knockback.

/bots add <number>
Add opponents on the ledge. Up to 32 bots per session.
/admin [on|off]
Turn admin on or off. Double-tap Space to toggle flight.
/fly [on|off]
Flight while admin is on. Hold Space to rise; C or Ctrl to descend.
/freecam [on|off]
Leave your body and fly the camera. WASD moves, Space rises, C/Ctrl descends, Shift speeds up. V returns. Your body keeps its gear, effects, and admin settings.
/targetme [on|off]
All bots cooperate against you. Off restores free-for-all.
/killall [everyone|bots]
Eliminate everyone, including you. Use /killall bots to spare yourself. No command rewards.
/2v2
Open match sign-up from the ledge.
/edit
Open the map editor for this arena.
/wave · /dance
Play an emote outside combat. Moving or attacking cancels it.
/heal
Restore health, remove effects, and refill healing potions to 3.
/coins 1000
Add coins while admin is on.
/give chargeorb
Grant a physical charge orb while admin is on. Equip Ascension, select the orb, then hold left click to pull fighters inward. Release to restore outward pressure.
/chargeorb on · off
Hold or release the selected orb by command. A held orb keeps charging in /freecam.
/give gemblade legendary fire
Give and equip a weapon while admin is on. Optional rarity and effect.
/spawn · /shop · /rank
Return to the ledge, open equipment, or check your rank.
/changelog · /clear · /help
Version history, clear chat, or this command list.

Sword: click for an instant slash. Hold for up to 1.2 seconds, then release a heavy follow-up. Full charge deals 2.4× damage with 1.65 seconds recovery. Blocking cancels the charge.

Weapon IDs: classic, dagger, broadsword, mace, gemblade, frost, venom, arcane, god.
Rarities: common, rare, epic, legendary. Effects: bleed, frost, fire.

This is a local game with AI opponents and simulated AI chat. Inventory and rank are saved in this browser.

2v2

Two teams. One life each. A separate courtyard with no friendly fire. Teams are balanced by combat skill.

Win: +80 coins · +25 EXP

100-second limit. Survivors, then remaining health, break ties. Admin powers are disabled during matches. R leaves the match.
